scope.description: RequestVote eligibility after one candidate-value StableStore write returns an error without changing that key, while prior successful term/key writes remain durable. Fixed configuration and accurate logs.
assumptions: Individual successful StableStore calls retain their values; an injected failed Set leaves its key unchanged.
The receiver continues along the implementation error-return path without an externally imposed process restart.
A prior vote for the stale candidate occurred only in an earlier term; the new-term attempt for another candidate was denied.
excluded: Any particular production storage backend frequency of this error
An observed elected stale leader or lost committed command
Byzantine requests, corrupt storage, membership/address changes

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No target source edits. skipStartup suppresses background loops; driver schedules campaigns and state transitions serially.

A term-2 election result is collected by the driver but its main-loop majority transition is delayed; B term-3 request reaches A while A is still Candidate, causing the real higher-term handler transition.

B majority transition is performed by the driver after observed A+self grants. Driver initializes one replication state matching startStopReplication and uses actual dispatchLogs/replicateTo for the term-3 no-op.

After the no-op replication, the driver lets the configured lease interval expire, invokes actual checkLeaderLease, performs the sourced runLeader-exit last-contact update and runs actual runFollower to its candidate transition. The enclosing runLeader cleanup is not executed; no prior replication worker remains running.
Transport replaces delivery with synchronous processRPC calls and explicit omissions; each candidate request comes from electSelf. No reply is forged.
StableStore wrapper returns one candidate-key Set error without changing the key; all other writes delegate to InmemStore. Successful-write control uses the same history without that error.

plan_uncertainties: No particular production storage backend is exercised; the error-return model is explicit.
Actual election RPC producers, log replication, lease checking and follower timeout execute; enclosing loop setup/cleanup and majority transitions remain driver-controlled.
No final stale-leader election or loss of a committed command is observed.
